# Tutorial 14: R to Python Cheat Sheet

| Task         | R                         | Python                             |
|:-----------------------|:-----------------------|:-----------------------|
| Load Library | `library(dplyr)`          | `import pandas as pd`              |
| Load CSV     | `read.csv("f.csv")`       | `pd.read_csv("f.csv")`             |
| Row Count    | `nrow(df)`                | `len(df)`                          |
| Filter       | `filter(df, age > 65)`    | `df[df['age'] > 65]`               |
| New Column   | `mutate(df, bmi = w/h^2)` | `df['bmi'] = df['w'] / df['h']**2` |
| Summary      | `summary(df$col)`         | `df['col'].describe()`             |
